relationships.subject: IncobotulinumtoxinA
relationships.evidence_quote: on day 56, after two administrations of Inco/A, sciatic nerves from the animals treated with the neurotoxin displayed a marked reduction in the CGRP signal compared to the vehicle-treated group

relationships.subject: IncobotulinumtoxinA
relationships.evidence_quote: perineural application of Inco/A exhibited a significant decrease (around 35%) in the inflammatory cell number compared to vehicle-treated animals

relationships.subject: IncobotulinumtoxinA
relationships.evidence_quote: Inco/A applied perineurally, to the sciatic nerve, accelerates functional recovery after nerve injury in rats by enhancing nerve regeneration

key_findings: Two perineural Inco/A doses improved SFI, CMAP latencies, myelination and NF200 signal after rat CCI.
Inco/A reduced CGRP, S100β and inflammatory cell infiltration at the injury site.
